Write a short article (at most 120 words) announcing that Ledgerly now exports VAT returns directly to HMRC. The publisher publishes the final text with publish_article.

Output of step 1:researcher:

**Ledgerly now files VAT returns directly to HMRC**

Ledgerly can now send your VAT returns straight to HMRC. You no longer need to export figures and re-enter them on the government portal.

Prepare your return in Ledgerly, review the figures, and submit. This removes a manual step where errors can creep in, and it saves time at every filing deadline.

The feature is available now in your Ledgerly account. Connect Ledgerly to your HMRC account once, and you can submit VAT returns from there each period.

Ledgerly's aim is to make compliance faster and less error-prone, so more of your time goes to running your business.

(Word count: 98)

Note for the publisher: I wrote this from the brief alone and found no product details to check it against. Before publishing, please confirm the connection and submission steps, any plan restrictions, and whether Ledgerly supports Making Tax Digital.
